title: QueryAttack: Jailbreaking Aligned Large Language Models Using Structured Non-natural Query Language
reasoning: The paper focuses on the security and robustness of LLMs, specifically proposing a jailbreak attack framework called QueryAttack. While it discusses bypassing safety alignment which is based on ethical and moral standards, its primary contribution is a technical attack method and its evaluation rather than a study or benchmark of ethics, morals, or religion themselves.
